description: This file is a PHP source code file for displaying the detail view of an Invoice in a SugarCRM-based application. It sets up various variables, retrieves invoice data, checks permissions, and renders a Smarty template for the invoice details.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a generic CRM entity with methods to retrieve entity info.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering views.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an instance of CRMEntity for a specific module.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves the information of a specific entity record.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Generates update information for the entity, possibly modification date, user, etc.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches the display blocks for the detail view.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceNumber
methods.description: Gets the sequence number for the module's records.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number field for the module, if any.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab category for the current module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission for an action on a record.

methods.name: getDetailAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Retrieves associated product details for the invoice.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks status of certain button permissions or states.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a given module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Fetches validation rules for a module's fields.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into structured arrays.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists exist for the module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related list data for the module.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for display purposes.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules stored in the session.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles navigation links for record detail views.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves boolean preferences for performance settings.

methods.name: getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Gets navigation info for list views and record navigation.

methods.name: getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all links of a certain type for a module's detail view.
